fit_reason: Whole aluminum fishing boat with trailer listed by a private owner in boats by owner.
findings: Dirt, leaves and organic debris packed along the floor ribs inside the hull
Grime and dirt on the floor around and under the bench seats
Dull, chalky oxidized aluminum along the port and starboard outer hull sides
Dusty, stained surfaces on the white bench seats
Grime and residue on the gunwale rails and transom area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Alumacraft fishing boat. The floor inside has a fair amount of dirt and debris packed between the ribs, and the outside of the aluminum hull looks dull and oxidized. We do pre-sale cleanups that come to you, including a clean-out and a polish of the hull to help it show better. Would you like a quote?
